en.rec: Score 79 on 6h 12m, 23:47 to 06:17. Three points under the night before and 45 minutes under the 6h 57m seven-night average — the shortest night on this board, and at the same time the best autonomic reading of the seven. Start with what went right, because it is the larger half. HRV came in at 50, five up on 45 and seven over the 43 average: the highest value anywhere in this window, ahead of Monday evening's 49. RHR held 53 for a fifth consecutive night, level with the 53 average and sitting on the floor of the range. Average stress reads 11 so far today against yesterday's finished 26, and body battery has charged 59 points overnight with nothing drained back out. Thursday's hack squat — 83 minutes, 19 sets, 16,980 kg, top set 200 kg, max HR 153 — cost you nothing autonomically; HRV went up, not down. The score came off duration, not disruption. Eighteen minutes awake, 95% sleep efficiency, no long fragmentation: the night was clean, there was simply less of it. Stages: light 4h 12m at 68%, REM 1h 08m at 18%, deep 52m at 14%. That deep total is the lowest of the seven nights here, against a window range of 1h 02m to 1h 28m, and REM is second-lowest. Deep and REM together made 2h 00m, 32% of the night — the thinnest restorative block on the board. That is the whole 79. And duration here is a bedtime problem, not a sleep problem. You went to bed at 23:47, the latest lights-out of the seven by one minute, and got the shortest sleep of the seven. The pattern is now unmistakable at both ends: your two latest bedtimes, 23:46 and 23:47, produced your two shortest nights, 6h 16m and 6h 12m; your earliest, 22:18, produced the longest at 8h 06m. Nothing about how you sleep is broken — the hours are simply not being handed to it. Readiness 85. HRV at a window high, RHR at its floor, no autonomic cost from Thursday's session: this is a green light, and the goblet squat is the session it should buy — 85 days since Jun 11 and the oldest gap on the board. Train today, then take the one lever that has been sitting there all week and get the lights out at 22:30 tonight.

hr.rec: Ocjena 79 uz 6h 12m, od 23:47 do 06:17. Tri boda ispod prethodne noći i 45 minuta ispod prosjeka od 6h 57m kroz sedam noći — najkraća noć na ovoj ploči, a istovremeno i najbolje autonomno očitanje od sedam. Počni od onoga što je dobro, jer je to veća polovica. HRV je bio 50, pet više od 45 i sedam iznad prosjeka od 43: najviša vrijednost bilo gdje u ovom prozoru, ispred ponedjeljkovih 49. RHR se petu noć zaredom zadržao na 53, jednak prosjeku od 53 i na samom dnu raspona. Prosječni stres danas zasad čita 11 naspram jučer završenih 26, a body battery se preko noći napunio za 59 bodova bez ijednog ispražnjenog. Četvrtkov hack čučanj — 83 minute, 19 serija, 16.980 kg, vršna serija 200 kg, maksimalni puls 153 — nije te koštao ništa autonomno; HRV je porastao, a ne pao. Ocjenu je odnijelo trajanje, a ne poremećenost sna. Osamnaest minuta budnosti, 95% učinkovitost, bez duge rascjepkanosti: noć je bila čista, samo je bilo manje. Faze: laki san 4h 12m i 68%, REM 1h 08m i 18%, duboki san 52m i 14%. Taj duboki zbroj najniži je od sedam noći ovdje, naspram raspona od 1h 02m do 1h 28m, a REM je drugi najniži. Duboki i REM zajedno dali su 2h 00m, 32% noći — najtanji obnavljajući blok na ploči. To je cijela priča o 79. A trajanje je ovdje pitanje lijeganja, ne kvalitete sna. Legao si u 23:47, najkasnije od sedam za jednu minutu, i dobio najkraći san od sedam. Obrazac je sada nedvojben na oba kraja: dva najkasnija lijeganja, 23:46 i 23:47, dala su dvije najkraće noći, 6h 16m i 6h 12m; najranije, 22:18, dalo je najdulju od 8h 06m. Ništa u načinu na koji spavaš nije pokvareno — sati mu se jednostavno ne daju. Spremnost 85. HRV na vrhuncu prozora, RHR na dnu, bez autonomnog računa od četvrtka: ovo je zeleno svjetlo, a goblet čučanj je trening koji bi ga trebao potrošiti — 85 dana od 11.6. i najstarija rupa na ploči. Treniraj danas, a onda povuci polugu koja cijeli tjedan stoji tu i ugasi svjetlo večeras u 22:30.
